tools.name: get_dashboard_summary
tools.description: High-level health of the workspace: connected integrations by status and the most recent account activity. Use this first to answer 'how is my business set up / what's connected'.

tools.name: list_integrations
tools.description: List the workspace's connected channels and data sources (Amazon, Flipkart, Snapdeal, Shopify, Meta, Google, etc.) with their connection status, health score, and last sync time.

tools.name: search_catalog
tools.description: Search the workspace's market-intelligence product catalog by free text (matches product title, brand, or internal SKU). Returns up to 25 matches with MRP, mapped-channel count, and status. Narrow the query if results are truncated. This is NOT the accounting product master: for HSN, tax rate, cost

tools.name: get_brand_score
tools.description: The latest brand-health score for the workspace — a weighted average across tracked marketplace listings (listing quality, reviews, availability, compliance). Returns the most recent day's score and the listing count it covers.

tools.name: get_channel_orders_overview
tools.description: Order volume across the workspace's connected non-Amazon marketplaces (Snapdeal, Flipkart, Myntra, JioMart, Meesho). Returns the order count synced per channel — use it to see which marketplaces have data and their relative scale.

tools.name: get_shelf_availability
tools.description: Quick-commerce on-shelf availability (OSA%) over the last 7 days, per channel — the share of observed shelves where the product was in stock. Lower is worse. Requires a Q-Radar subscription.

tools.name: list_stores
tools.description: List every connected store/marketplace account (Amazon, Shopify, Flipkart, Snapdeal, Meesho, Myntra, JioMart, Ajio, offline) with its display name, country/currency, and order count in the last 30 days.

tools.name: get_pnl_summary
tools.description: AMAZON ONLY. Amazon settlement-based money summary over a window: revenue, marketplace fees, refunds, TCS/TDS, net amount Amazon settled, FBA reimbursements, net to seller, plus order/return/reimbursement counts. Amounts are in major currency units. For P&L across all channels (margin, COGS, unpaid

tools.name: get_orders_summary
tools.description: Order volume per channel over a window, across all connected marketplaces. Use it to see where orders are coming from and the relative scale per channel.

tools.name: get_payments_summary
tools.description: Settlement/payment activity: the net amount Amazon settled over the window (major units) plus the all-time count of settlement/payment records synced per channel (a sync check, not money). For payouts on any channel use get_settlement_cycles; for orders not yet paid use get_unpaid_orders.

tools.name: get_returns_summary
tools.description: AMAZON ONLY. Amazon returns over a window: total count, total units, and the top return reasons. For returns on any channel use search_returns; for a scan problem use diagnose_return_scan.

tools.name: get_reimbursements_summary
tools.description: Amazon FBA reimbursements over a window: total amount (major units), count, units, and the top reimbursement reasons.

tools.name: get_inventory
tools.description: Warehouse stock levels by SKU (available, reserved, incoming, blocked) joined to the master product (name, cost, MRP). Optional free-text search by SKU; returns up to 25 rows.

tools.name: get_stock_status
tools.description: Out-of-stock status across tracked marketplace listings: total listings, OOS count, OOS breakdown by channel, and a sample of the currently out-of-stock listings.

tools.name: list_sellers
tools.description: Sellers observed on tracked listings (the competitive seller universe) with their classification and rating. Optional channel filter.

tools.name: list_competitors
tools.description: Operator-curated competitors being tracked, with priority and status.

tools.name: get_compliance_violations
tools.description: Minimum-advertised-price / MRP compliance violations: open + escalated counts, breakdown by channel, and the most recent open violations.

tools.name: get_margin_config
tools.description: Per-product margin models from market intelligence: COGS and platform-fee percentage, optionally per channel. Returns up to 25 rows. NOT the cost the P&L uses: for a missing cost price use get_product_master or diagnose_pnl.

tools.name: get_marketplace_alerts
tools.description: Marketplace alert events (price drops, OOS, MAP breaches, etc.) fired in a window: counts by type and severity, plus the most recent events.

tools.name: get_psl_movers
tools.description: Top potential-sales-loss (PSL) movers from quick-commerce shelf intelligence over a window — the products losing the most estimated sales to out-of-stock, by channel. Requires a Q-Radar subscription.

tools.name: get_tax_summary
tools.description: GST snapshot for a period: taxable value, CGST/SGST/IGST/cess, total tax and invoice count (B2B + B2C split), plus TCS and TDS collected per channel. India GST. The GST values come from Amazon GST (MTR) reports only: sales on other channels are not in them, so say so instead of calling a low figure

tools.name: get_gstr1_summary
tools.description: GSTR-1 outward-supply summary for a period: B2B / B2CL / B2CS section totals and the HSN-wise rollup, for return preparation. Built from Amazon GST (MTR) reports only; other channels are not included.

tools.name: get_hsn_summary
tools.description: Per-HSN-code tax rollup (taxable value, CGST/SGST/IGST/cess, invoice count) for a period. Amazon GST (MTR) reports only; lines with a blank HSN are left out (check get_product_master).

tools.name: get_state_wise_tax
tools.description: Per-state outward-supply and tax breakdown (taxable value, CGST/SGST/IGST, invoice count, intra/inter-state) for a period. Amazon GST (MTR) reports only.

tools.name: get_tax_mismatches
tools.description: Lines where the stored tax doesn't equal rate × taxable value (drift audit), with per-line drift amounts and workflow state. Defaults to open items.

tools.name: get_fba_health
tools.description: Amazon FBA inventory health: aging buckets (0-90 … 365+ days), long-term storage-fee exposure, and recommended actions (e.g. remove/restock).

tools.name: get_marketing_summary
tools.description: Cross-platform ad performance for a window: spend, impressions, clicks, conversions, revenue, ROAS, CTR, CPC, with prior-period deltas and a per-platform breakdown (Google/Meta/Amazon Ads, etc.).

tools.name: list_campaigns
tools.description: Ad campaigns across connected platforms with per-campaign performance (spend, conversions, ROAS, status) for a window. Requires the campaigns module.

tools.name: get_analytics_summary
tools.description: Google Analytics 4 summary for a window: sessions, users, new users, conversions, engagement, revenue, and source breakdown.

tools.name: get_seo_queries
tools.description: Google Search Console summary for a window: top search queries with impressions, clicks, average position and CTR. Requires the SEO module.

tools.name: get_serp_keywords
tools.description: Tracked SEO keywords with current rankings, search volume, intent and rank trend. Requires the SERP module.

tools.name: list_coach_recommendations
tools.description: AI Coach recommendations inbox: detected issues/opportunities with severity and state (open by default), plus AI-generated action plans.

tools.name: get_ai_wallet
tools.description: AI spend wallet: balance, month-to-date spend, monthly cap, auto-recharge status, and last top-up.

tools.name: get_notifications
tools.description: In-app notifications inbox: recent alerts with severity, title, and state.

tools.name: get_account_profile
tools.description: The workspace profile: user details and the corporate/tenant profile (legal name, tax IDs, address, reporting currency, completeness).

tools.name: list_team_members
tools.description: Workspace members with their roles and effective permissions. Requires org member-read permission (Owner/Admin).

tools.name: get_brand_pack
tools.description: Brand identity configuration: logo, colors, fonts, voice attributes, banned phrases, required disclaimers.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search the workspace's product catalogue by free text (title, brand, or SKU). Returns matching products as citeable results with stable ids — pass an id to `fetch` for full detail. Built for deep-research and retrieval workflows.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Fetch the full detail of a result returned by `search`, by its id (e.g. "product:<id>"). Returns citeable product records (document text) for deep-research workflows.

tools.name: search_orders
tools.description: Find specific orders across all connected channels. `query` matches an order ID, line-item ID, or SKU (substring). Filter by channel, attribution state, and date range. Money fields are in minor units (paise for INR) — convert to ₹. Use get_order for full detail on one order.

tools.name: get_order
tools.description: Full detail for a single order by channel + line-item ID, including the linked return (if any) and channel-specific fields. Money is in minor units (paise for INR). Get the channel + lineItemId from search_orders.

tools.name: search_returns
tools.description: Find specific returns across all connected channels. `query` matches a return ID, order ID or reverse-shipment tracking (AWB) number, matched from the start of the stored id and case-sensitively (send the full id as printed; for a failed scan use diagnose_return_scan). Filter by channel, return buck

tools.name: search_inventory
tools.description: Find inventory for a specific product across all channels. `query` matches product name, accounting SKU, brand, or variant SKU (substring). Each result is master-grain with per-channel / per-store / per-warehouse stock (available, reserved, in-transit) and a health state (stockout, alert, low, healt

tools.name: search_oms_orders
tools.description: Orders flowing through the zobship fulfillment pipeline, with their state (new → reserved → awaiting_label → labelled → manifested → shipped …), fulfillment type, credit status, and expected ship date. Filter by channel, state, store, warehouse, or exact variant/channel SKU.

tools.name: get_oms_order
tools.description: Full detail for one fulfillment order: line items (SKU, qty, picked/reserved), lifecycle history (state transitions with timestamps), credit consumption, pickup slot, and resolved shipping city/state. Get the id from search_oms_orders.

tools.name: list_picklists
tools.description: Warehouse pick waves (draft → assigned → picking → completed), with line count, expected ship date, and whether a pick PDF exists.

tools.name: get_picklist
tools.description: One picklist: assigned picker, line references, group key, timestamps, and a short-lived pick-PDF link.

tools.name: list_manifests
tools.description: Courier hand-over manifests (draft → submitted → acknowledged), with shipment + order counts and submit/acknowledge timestamps. Filter by warehouse and date range.

tools.name: get_manifest
tools.description: One manifest: shipment + order id lists, state, and a short-lived manifest-PDF link.

tools.name: list_pickers
tools.description: The warehouse-floor picker roster (name, code, phone, assigned warehouse, active status).

tools.name: get_zobship_credits
tools.description: The fulfillment-credit wallet balance (free + paid, in minor units — convert to ₹), paid-credit expiry, and the available recharge tiers. Separate from the AI wallet.

tools.name: get_qradar_overview
tools.description: Quick-commerce shelf-intelligence headline: on-shelf-availability % (OSA), shelves & SKUs tracked, average risk score, potential-sales-loss (PSL, in paise — convert to ₹), pincode coverage, and a daily trendline. Use for 'how is my quick-commerce availability'.

tools.name: list_qradar_skus
tools.description: SKUs in the Q-Radar rotation with current OSA %, risk score, shelf counts, and pricing. Sort by osa_asc to surface the worst-availability SKUs, or filter to those under a target OSA. Own vs competitor SKUs.

tools.name: get_qradar_sku_history
tools.description: Time-series of shelf evaluations for one master product across pincodes and dark-stores in the window — risk score, lever scores, in-stock state, inventory, and price per observation. Get the master id from list_qradar_skus.

tools.name: get_qradar_leak_ledger
tools.description: The CFO-grade potential-sales-loss (PSL) ledger: each out-of-stock window with lost units and lost revenue (paise — convert to ₹), the velocity basis, price/MRP, and an audit hash chain. Ranked by impact.

tools.name: get_qradar_distribution
tools.description: Numeric distribution %: where a quick-commerce platform operates vs where the brand is actually listed, store-type reach (express / instant / longtail), per-state coverage, and a ranked list of gap pincodes with opportunity value (paise). Use for 'where should I expand on Blinkit'.

tools.name: get_qradar_sov
tools.description: Keyword share-of-search on quick-commerce: organic and sponsored presence in the top 5 / 10 / 20 results per tracked keyword and channel. Filter to one keyword or list the highest-organic keywords.

tools.name: list_qradar_alerts
tools.description: Quick-commerce anomaly alerts: out-of-stock spikes, price anomalies, risk escalations, and critical-stock events, with severity and the affected SKU / channel / pincode.

tools.name: get_sync_status
tools.description: Is each marketplace connection healthy, when did data last arrive, and is anything stale or blocked (billing pause, needs credentials)? Use for 'my Flipkart/Myntra/Amazon data is not updating' questions. Optionally filter by channel.

tools.name: get_marketplace_login_issues
tools.description: For 'login failed' / 'not syncing' on Myntra, Flipkart, Meesho or Snapdeal: each store's connection status, last successful sync, whether the last attempt failed at login, who has to act (the seller's password vs Zobrx's side), and whether Zobrx has paused that channel.

tools.name: get_report_jobs
tools.description: Recent marketplace report jobs (Flipkart payment/settlement reports, Amazon reports) and CSV exports from the last 7 days, with their state. A job that is pending/processing is still running — do not call it failed. Use for 'my report isn't updating' / 'my export never arrived'.

tools.name: get_tally_sync_status
tools.description: The last few Tally Prime sync runs: when, what was pushed, how many vouchers were created/altered, and whether Tally reported errors. Use for 'my Tally sync failed'. Read-only — never changes accounting data.

tools.name: get_tax_credit_status
tools.description: Reconciliation state of marketplace TCS (per channel, per month) or TDS u/s 194-O (per channel, per FY): whether what Zobrx expects matches what the marketplace/portal reports. A 'discrepancy' is a fact to explain, not a claim that credit was received or lost.

tools.name: get_support_tickets
tools.description: The account's most recent support tickets with their status. Use for 'what's happening with my ticket'.

tools.name: search_help_kb
tools.description: Search Zobrx's published help articles. Write the query in ENGLISH even if the seller wrote in Hindi or Hinglish — the index is English. Returns up to 3 articles with a relevance score.

tools.name: get_subscription_status
tools.description: The workspace's Zobrx subscription: plan, modules, current billing period with its END date (the renewal/expiry date), days left, trial end, and the order allowance for the period (assigned, used, remaining, unlimited, exhausted). Use for 'when is my renewal', 'is my plan active', 'how many orders a

tools.name: diagnose_pnl
tools.description: Explains a seller's settled P&L for a period: revenue, fees, COGS and margin overall and per channel, unpaid (unsettled) orders/returns, unmapped SKUs, SKUs with no cost price, why a channel shows zero fees, and the worst-margin SKUs. Covers Amazon, Flipkart, Meesho, Myntra, Snapdeal, JioMart, Shopi

tools.name: get_settlement_cycles
tools.description: Answers 'when will I be paid / what did I receive': period totals of settled vs upcoming payout money, the pending or deferred cycles with their expected amounts, and the last payout per channel. All marketplaces with a settlement feed; default window is the last 90 days.

tools.name: get_unpaid_orders
tools.description: Counts orders the seller has not been paid out for yet (awaiting marketplace settlement), per channel and by age, with a sample of the newest. Orders are windowed on order date, default the last 30 days; a very long window can time out on large sellers.

tools.name: get_recon_flags
tools.description: Lists settlement cycles whose net payout differs from the expected net by more than 5% of gross, with total estimated leakage. Amazon, Flipkart, Meesho, Myntra, Snapdeal; default last 90 days. Estimates against a per-channel baseline fee %, not the seller's rate card.

tools.name: get_fee_breakdown
tools.description: Marketplace fees by type (commission, shipping, reverse shipping, fixed, collection, pick-and-pack) per channel for a period, with rate-card gaps (possible over-charges) only where a rate card exists. Flipkart, Amazon, Meesho, Myntra, JioMart, Ajio; default last 30 days. Pass feeType for one type (f

tools.name: get_claims_summary
tools.description: Claimable returns: counts by eligibility (eligible, filed, approved, rejected, expired), value at stake, and the most urgent claims with their deadlines. Only Amazon SAFE-T and Flipkart disputes are claimable; default window is returns from the last 90 days.

tools.name: get_operating_costs
tools.description: Period costs not tied to an order (advertising, storage, penalties, platform fees, reimbursements) by type and channel; these sit outside SKU P&L margin. Amazon and Flipkart only, on settlement date; default last 30 days.

tools.name: get_tally_sync_errors
tools.description: Why a Tally Prime sync failed: the latest 10 runs with created/altered/error counts and a classified failureKind (missing_ledger, missing_stock_item, missing_voucher_type, tally_unreachable, empty_push, ...), naming the missing master when Tally does. Tally reports only the first missing master per

tools.name: get_tally_ledger_coverage
tools.description: Which ledgers and voucher types Zobrx's vouchers need that the Tally company does not have, all at once (Tally itself names only one per push). Based on the last masters snapshot the Tally extension synced (see fetchedAt); stock items are not checked here.

tools.name: get_zoho_sync_status
tools.description: Whether Zoho Books is connected, the auto-sync's last run and result, the 10 most recent failed pushes with a classified kind (auth, tax, missing_item, ...), and how many master SKUs have no Zoho item.

tools.name: get_export_status
tools.description: Recent report exports (orders, returns, P&L, GST/sales registers, inventory, products...): state, row count, whether truncated, and why a failed one failed. A run with no progress for 6 minutes is reported as stalled.

tools.name: get_product_master
tools.description: Look up a catalog master product by SKU, name, HSN or a mapped marketplace SKU: HSN, GST tax group and rate, cost, status. For a single match also combo lines, variants, dated cost and per-channel mapping. Use for wrong GST, missing cost or combo questions.

tools.name: get_unmapped_listings
tools.description: Marketplace listings not yet mapped to a catalog master: total, count per channel, and up to 10 channel SKUs. Unmapped SKUs carry no cost or tax setup, so P&L margin and Tally/Zoho vouchers miss them.

tools.name: get_sku_mapping_health
tools.description: How much recent sales value sits on SKUs not mapped to a catalog master (so margin and COGS are wrong), the top unmapped SKUs, and per-channel diagnostics (orders found, stores no longer linked). Covers Amazon, Flipkart, Meesho, Myntra, Snapdeal, Shopify, JioMart, Ajio, offline.

tools.name: diagnose_return_scan
tools.description: Replays the mobile app's return-scan lookup for a code and says what the scanner shows: found, already received, Amazon FBA (nothing to receive), several shipments match, or not found with likely causes. Use for 'scan says return not found' or 'can't receive this return'.

tools.name: get_return_receipt_status
tools.description: For a received return (AWB, order id or return id): when and how it was received, whether it went back into stock and if not why (damaged/lost, no warehouse, SKU not mapped, qty 0), and whether the new stock reached each marketplace. Use for 'I received the return but stock didn't increase'.

tools.name: get_return_receive_backlog
tools.description: Merchant-fulfilled returns not yet marked received: total pending, how many are older than 15 days (stock not restocked, claim windows running), oldest age, per-channel counts and the oldest examples. Optionally one channel.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "get_sync_status" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "diagnose_return_scan" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_brand_score, list_coach_recommendations, get_notifications, get_marketplace_login_issues, get_support_tickets, get_settlement_cycles · Private data: get_payments_summary, get_ai_wallet, fetch, search_returns, get_zobship_credits, get_sync_status, get_marketplace_login_issues · Public sink: get_shelf_availability, search_returns, list_manifests, get_qradar_sov · Destructive: get_fba_health, get_zoho_sync_status, get_export_status.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_brand_score, list_coach_recommendations, get_notifications, get_marketplace_login_issues, get_support_tickets, get_settlement_cycles · Private data: get_payments_summary, get_ai_wallet, fetch, search_returns, get_zobship_credits, get_sync_status, get_marketplace_login_issues · Public sink: get_shelf_availability, search_returns, list_manifests, get_qradar_sov · Destructive: get_fba_health, get_zoho_sync_status, get_export_status

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_catalog" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
